diagnostics.message: signalfx_aws_integration.integration only depends on aws_iam_role.splunk_integration (via role_arn) and the time_sleep delay, but not on aws_iam_role_policy.splunk_integration, which attaches the actual read permissions (EC2/CloudWatch/etc.) the integration needs to assume the role and pull data. If the integration is created before this policy is attached, its initial sync can fail. It should depend on aws_iam_role_policy.splunk_integration.

signalfx_aws_integration.integration sets use_metric_streams_sync = true, which per the provider docs requires the IAM role to have the CloudWatch metric-stream actions and iam:PassRole — exactly the permissions granted by aws_iam_role_policy.splunk_managed_policy. The integration does not depend on this policy, so it could be created before the metric-stream permissions are attached. It should depend on aws_iam_role_policy.splunk_managed_policy.
